Games Action Games Grand Theft Auto GTA 6 18 years later, GTA 6 redeems Grand Theft Auto's most annoying meme by turning it into something useful News By Iain Harris Published 30 October 2026 Scooter brothers! We're scooter brothers! When you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here's how it works . (Image credit: Rockstar Games) Copy link Facebook X Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Rockstar is keeping a good thing going with GTA 6 . That being, the Scooter Brothers - a Grand Theft Auto meme that's slowly being a mainstay in the series. Back when GTA 4 was released many a moon ago, one of the most viral videos from it featured a player who - while on a scooter - came across an NPC - on a scooter. Feeling a strong sense of kinship, the player shouts "scooter brothers!" and several other things. The video now has 7.5 million views on YouTube . The beauty of Scooter Brothers is in its simplicity and enthusiastic delivery. Of course, Rockstar didn't leave things there. When swapping to Trevor in GTA 5 , there's a chance you'll find him - on a scooter - coming across an NPC - on a scooter. You see where we're going with this, yes? Latest Videos From GamesRadar+ Watch full video here: So what's Rockstar got in store for GTA 6? Eagle-eyed fans thought something might be coming thanks to promotional material, but thankfully, Edge now has the definitive answer . An answer that pleasingly involves the Scooter Bros. moving up in the world. If Jason or Lucia require their vehicle at any point in their Vice City romp, you can open your phone and the Scooter Bros. app will be waiting for you. Use it, and someone will be along shortly with your wheels before wheeling off themself into the sunset - on a scooter, naturally. It'll cost you a pretty penny, but we think the Scooter Brothers have earned your support at this point.
